main.description: Apply or negate a moderation label on a record or an account. Only for allowlisted moderation services. The service derives the affected boundary itself.

neg.description: If true, negate a prior label with the same subject and value. Absent means false.

ref.description: Optional moderation-service reference for this action, such as a report or case identifier.

label.description: The resulting label. Absent only when the request changed nothing and the subject has no label.

errors.name: SubjectNotFound
errors.description: The subject record or account does not exist on this service.
